#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
#| 



labels_place_type <- c(
  "concert" = "Concert/Theatre/Show",
  "theatre/show" = "Concert/Theatre/Show",
  "darkroom" = "Dark Room/Sex Party",
  "sex-party" = "Dark Room/Sex Party",
  "dance-party" = "Dance Party",
  "sport-game" = "Sport Game",
  "private-residence-" = "Private Residence",
  "something-else" = "Something Else"
)
  


 working_data <- targets::tar_read(places_data) %>%
   mutate(placeType = factor(placeType, names(labels_place_type), labels_place_type)) %>%
   mutate(placeSex = factor(placeSex, c("no", "yes"), c("Social\nContact", "Sexual\nContact"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(placeSex)) 
  
figure_n_counts <-  working_data %>%
                                group_by(distanceFromHome) %>%
                                summarize(n = n() )



working_data  %>%
                                arrange(placeType,  distanceFromHome) %>%
  group_by(placeType, distanceFromHome) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
   group_by(  distanceFromHome) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
                                mutate(prop_label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 1)) %>%
                                ggplot() +
                                geom_bar(aes(x = placeType, y = proportion, fill = placeType), stat = "identity", width = 1) +
                                #geom_text(aes(x = level, y = proportion, label = prop_label), color = "black", nudge_y = 0.35, size = 3) +
                                geom_text(aes(x = 0, y = -0.8, label = paste("n =", n)), data = figure_n_counts, size = 4) +
                                facet_grid( . ~ distanceFromHome, switch = "y") +
                                coord_polar() +
                                scale_fill_manual("", values = c(dark_blue, light_blue, dark_purple, light_purple, dark_pink, light_pink, light_green, dark_green))    +
                                scale_color_manual(values = c(
                                  "Dance Party" = dark_blue, 
                                  "Sport Game" = light_blue, 
                                  "Dark Room/Sex Party" = dark_purple, 
                                  "Concert/Theatre/Show" = light_purple, 
                                  "Private Residence" = dark_pink, 
                                  "Something Else" = light_pink))    +
                                theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text    = element_text( hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text.y  = element_text(),
      plot.margin   = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
      plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(1, 0, 15, 0, "mm")),
      plot.caption = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0, "mm"))
      ) +
                                scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25, 0.50, 1), limits = c(-0.8, 1)) +
    labs(
          title    = captions_and_titles("placessexcontactdistance")$title,
          subtitle = captions_and_titles("placessexcontactdistance")$subtitle,
          caption  = captions_and_titles("placessexcontactdistance")$caption
          )
